name: DCA Aunt Cass Café / San Fransokyo Baymax Macaron (Chocolate-Hazelnut Ganache & Buttercream)
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café & Lucky Fortune Cookery (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Unlike berry macarons, the adorable white Baymax Macaron is filled with smooth chocolate-hazelnut spread and buttercream—completely free of berry seeds and citrus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share a Baymax Macaron in San Fransokyo Square and take a lactase enzyme tablet for the buttercream.
watchOuts: Contains almond flour and hazelnut spread (tree nuts) plus dairy buttercream
